https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/english_edit.title: People’s tribunal urges US to compensate Korean victims of A-bombings
https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/english_edit.p1: The US atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki in 1945 were war crimes against civilians, so the US government ought to compensate the Korean victims, an international people’s tribunal has ruled. The International People’s Tribunal on the 1945 Atomic Bombings found in a preliminary judgment on Sunday that the US bombings of the two Japanese cities in August 1945 constituted war crimes, violating international legal prohibitions on direct attacks on civilians even during total war. The bombings killed approximately 210,000 people, including 40,000 Koreans.
https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/english_edit.p2: The tribunal concluded that the US government is obligated to compensate the Korean victims. The Organizing Committee of the International People’s Tribunal on the 1945 Atomic Bombings and the Korean civic group Solidarity for Peace and Reunification of Korea (SPARK) convened the tribunal from Nov. 13 to 15 at Hanshin University’s Graduate School of Theology in the Suyu neighborhood of Seoul’s Gangbuk District. As the tribunal was organized by civilians, its judgment is not legally binding. Nevertheless, it marks the first attempt in the world to put the US government on trial for its use of atomic bombs. In its judgment, the panel of judges found that “atomic bombings constituted war crimes and crimes against humanity under customary international law as it stood in 1945.” “The atomic bombings constituted war crimes, as the wanton destruction of cities was not justifiable by military necessity. They also constituted crimes against humanity, as they were planned acts of mass killing directed against civilians,” the judges found. The judges also concluded that “the United States is under an obligation under international law to compensate Korean atomic bomb victims for the harm they suffered” — and, indeed, continue to suffer — “as a result of the atomic bombings.” The judges found that the bombings violated prohibitions against direct attacks on civilians, indiscriminate attacks and methods of warfare that “would violate laws of humanity and public conscience.” They also concluded that the bombings exceeded what was necessary for legitimate military purposes and violated the requirements of necessity and proportionality. Twelve Korean plaintiffs participated in the proceedings, including seven individuals who survived direct exposure to the bombings, as well as four second-generation victims and one third-generation victim with conditions attributed to their parents’ and grandparents’ radiation exposure. Among them was Shim Jin-tae, head of the Hapcheon chapter of the Korea Atomic Bombs Victim Association.

https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/english_edit.title: US-China-Russia summit mustn’t become a ‘second Yalta,’ says South Korea’s top diplomat
https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/english_edit.p1: South Korea’s foreign minister said a summit between North Korea and the US on the sidelines of this week’s Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen, China, remains possible but unlikely. Seoul’s top diplomat also said he had conveyed to China that any decisions reached at a potential summit between the leaders of the US, China and Russia must not undermine South Korea’s national interests. Speaking to reporters at the Korean Embassy in Beijing on Saturday, Foreign Minister Cho discussed his meeting with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi the previous day, which lasted about 90 minutes and was followed by a dinner. A senior South Korean Foreign Ministry official said the Chinese side had shared its assessment of the prospects for a North Korea-US summit. “Ultimately, the most important variables are the situation in the US and President Donald Trump’s willingness to hold a summit. Another variable is how receptive North Korea will be,” the official said. “Taking everything into account, we cannot rule out the possibility under the current circumstances,” the official continued. “We need to be prepared and ensure that our national interests aren’t compromised.” Seoul also conveyed its opposition to a repeat of the 1945 Yalta Conference, at which the major powers decided the postwar international order without involving the countries that were directly affected. “If a US-China-Russia summit takes place, it must not become a ‘second Yalta Conference,’“ the official said. “We’ve made it clear not only to the US but also to China that our national interests cannot be compromised on matters concerning the Korean Peninsula. We made that position abundantly clear again yesterday.” The official said that China understands South Korea’s position that the three powers must not make decisions that would grant North Korea recognition as a nuclear-armed state or thwart efforts to establish a peace regime on the Korean Peninsula. The South Korean delegation also received an update on recent exchanges between China and North Korea. The official said the Chinese side had provided “relatively detailed accounts” of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un’s visit to Dandong on Oct. 24 and Korean Workers’ Party international secretary Kim Song-nam’s visit to China on Nov. 5. “The Chinese side described relations with North Korea as focusing more on economic cooperation than on political matters, and that was very much the impression I came away with,” the official said. Cho said that he had emphasized that peace on the Korean Peninsula was a “vital interest” for South Korea and that Wang had agreed that peace and stability on the peninsula were also in China’s national interest. Regarding bilateral relations, Cho said China had expressed its intention to give President Lee Jae Myung a special welcome during his visit for the APEC summit. With the 35th anniversary of diplomatic relations approaching next year, the two countries agreed that discussions would continue at the working level about concrete cooperation projects with a meaningful public impact that can be announced at the APEC summit next week. The talks also covered longstanding issues raised by Korea, including Chinese structures installed in the Yellow Sea. The Chinese said they would make a good-faith effort to address those issues. Cho said the two sides also agreed on the need to reduce negative sentiment among their respective populations and move bilateral relations in a mutually positive direction.

https://www.kmib.co.kr/list/598.title: 국민일보
https://www.kmib.co.kr/list/598.p2: 아세안(ASEAN·동남아시아국가연합) 정상회의 참석을 위해 필리핀을 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 “지정학적 갈등과 경제적 불확실성이 심화될수록 한국과 아세안은 더 긴밀히 연대해야 한다”고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 16일(현지시간) 필리핀 수도 마닐라에서 열린 한·아세안 정상회의 모두발언에서 “국제 정세의 불확실성이 커질수록 역내 협력의 구심점인 아세안의 역할이 더욱 중요해지고 있다”며 “대한민국은 ‘아세안 중심성’을 확고히 지지한다“고 말했다. 이 대통령은 양측 간 공조가 초국가적 치안 협력 분야에서 빛을 발하고 있다고 강조하면서 “한국과 아세안은 온라인에서부터 바다에 이르기까지 양측 국민의 생명과 안전을 함께 지켜나갈 것”이라고 말했다. 또 “한·아세안 자유무역협정(FTA) 개선 협상도 시작됐다”며 “변화하는 글로벌 통상 환경에 선제적으로 대응하며 연간 교역액 3000억 달러 시대를 향해 나아가겠다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이번 정상회의를 계기로 ‘한·아세안 인공지능(AI) 동행 이니셔티브’와 ‘한·아세안 문화 창조산업 이니셔티브’를 제안했다. 이를 통해 AI 기술 발전 혜택을 양국 국민이 함께 누리게 하고, 아세안 청년의 문화적 창의성이 구체적 성과로 이어지는 데 한국이 기여하겠다는 것이다. 이어진 비공개 회의에서 아세안 각국 정상은 이 대통령이 지난해 제시한 ‘한·아세안 포괄적 전략동반자 관계(CSP) 비전’의 성과를 높이 평가하고, 이를 계속 이행·지지하겠다는 뜻을 밝혔다고 김성완 청와대 대변인이 서면브리핑에서 밝혔다. 김 대변인은 “각국 정상은 한·아세안 FTA 개선 협상 타결과 AI·디지털 전환, 에너지·전력망 등 분야에서의 협력 강화와 초국가 범죄 공동대응 등을 희망했다”고 전했다. 이에 이 대통령은 아세안 기대에 부응하기 위해 CSP의 각 비전별 구체적인 협력사업 계획을 제시했다. 이 대통령은 한·메콩 정상회의를 갖고 메콩강 유역 5개국(캄보디아·라오스·미얀마·태국·베트남)과 협력 강화 방안도 논의했다. 이 대통령은 “대한민국이야말로 메콩 국가들의 발전 과정을 함께할 최적의 파트너”라며 “한·아세안 CSP 비전을 실현하는 과정에서 메콩의 역동성과 잠재력이 발휘될 수 있도록 적극 지원하고 7대 중점 협력 분야를 중심으로 실질적이고 호혜적인 협력을 더욱 강화하겠다”고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 순방 첫날인 이날 아누틴 찬위라꾼 태국 총리, 페르디난드 로무알데스 마르코스 주니어 필리핀 대통령과 각각 정상회담을 갖고 양국 간 협력 확대 방안을 논의했다. 한·태국 정상회담에서는 양 정상이 포괄적 경제동반자협정(CEPA)의 조속한 타결에 공감을 표하면서 협상을 가속하기로 했다. 또 필리핀과의 정상회담에서는 방산과 인프라 등 협력 분야에서 호혜적 협력을 심화하고 조선·AI·원전·우주 등 유망 분야에서 미래지향적 협력을 확대 발전시켜 나가기로 했다고 김 대변인이 전했다.

http://www.washingtonexaminer.com/op-eds.title: North Korea nixed unification from its constitution. What we should prepare for
http://www.washingtonexaminer.com/op-eds.p1: North Korea has removed references to unification from its constitution. On Wednesday, North Korea released the full text of its revised constitution through Naenara, a state-run propaganda website. The constitution, amended by the Supreme People’s Assembly on March 23, removed provisions concerning peaceful reunification and the great unity of the Korean nation. Instead, it introduced a new provision defining North Korea’s territory as bordering China and Russia to the north and South Korea to the south. The constitutional framework that once viewed the two Koreas as one nation destined for reunification has effectively been abandoned.
http://www.washingtonexaminer.com/op-eds.p2: This is more than a change in wording. Since late 2023, Kim Jong Un has defined inter-Korean relations as a relationship between two hostile states. The following year, he ordered the removal of references to unification from the constitution. North Korea has since rejected the idea that the two Koreas belong to the same nation and shifted toward treating South Korea as a separate state rather than a partner for reconciliation and reunification. The publication of the revised constitution confirms that these political declarations have now been incorporated into the country’s highest legal framework. North Korea is changing the very way it defines its relationship with South Korea .

https://www.etnews.com/20261117000207.title: [人사이트] 최종복 직스테크놀로지 대표 “CAD 국산화 다음은 설계 생태계 혁신” - 전자신문
https://www.etnews.com/20261117000207.p1: “직스캐드 AX로 경쟁 제품을 대체하고 AI를 넣어 한 단계 나아갔다면, 다음은 설계 생태계를 바꾸는 단계입니다. 국산 컴퓨터지원설계(CAD)의 기술력과 생태계를 키워 국내 기업의 외산 소프트웨어(SW) 의존도를 낮추겠습니다.” 최종복 직스테크놀로지 대표는 최근 본지와 인터뷰에서 이같이 강조했다. 국내 고객과 협력해 확보한 실무 도면을 인공지능(AI)에 학습시키고, 이를 설계 현장에 맞는 제품 경쟁력으로 발전시키겠다는 구상이다. 직스테크놀로지는 외산 CAD 제품을 유통하며 쌓은 경험과 수익을 자체 개발에 투자해 지난 2022년 직스캐드 첫 버전을 출시했다. 그간 연구·개발(R&D)에 300억원 이상을 투입했고, 한화오션·삼성물산·현대스틸·국방과학연구소 등 대기업과 공공기관으로 고객 기반을 넓히고 있다. 국산 CAD '직스캐드 AX', AI 공간 설계 플랫폼 '직스 스페이스', 건설현장 관제 플랫폼 '다이브' 등을 개발하고 있다. 최 대표는 “대기업은 단순히 저렴하다고 제품을 도입하지 않고 수개월간 테스트와 검토를 거친다”며 “최근 국내 대기업과 중견기업이 외산 CAD에서 직스 CAD로 바꾸기 시작했다는 것은 이 같은 과정을 모두 통과했다는 점에서 의미가 있다”고 말했다. 최 대표가 내세운 기술 자산은 실무 도면의 확보 규모와 이를 활용한 AI 학습 경험이다. AI 공간 설계 플랫폼 '직스 스페이스'는 10만 장 이상의 도면을 학습한 모델을 활용한다. 외산 경쟁사보다 국내 고객의 도면을 많이 확보해 자체 AI 모델에 학습시켜 왔다는 설명이다. 최 대표는 “데이터는 양뿐 아니라 품질이 매우 중요하다”며 “고객이 현업에서 사용하는 고품질 도면을 자체 모델에 계속 학습시켜 실제 설계 업무에 필요한 성능을 높이고 있다”고 설명했다. 이어 “국내 산업 현장의 도면 데이터와 자체 AI 기술을 바탕으로 국산 CAD 생태계를 키워가겠다”고 덧붙였다. 특히 직스테크놀로지는 설계 분야 AI 전환(AX)에 속도를 내고 있다. AI가 종이·이미지 도면을 인식해 수정 가능한 설계 데이터로 바꾸고, 이를 2D·3D 공간 구성과 시뮬레이션에 활용하도록 돕는다. 확보한 시간은 더 다양한 설계안을 검토하고 공간의 품질을 높이는 데 활용할 수 있다. 최 대표는 “기획과 실시설계에 시간이 많이 들어가면 디자인 품질을 높일 시간이 부족해진다”며 “더 많은 대안을 시뮬레이션하고 사람이 더 나은 공간을 선택하도록 돕는 것이 AX의 가치”라고 설명했다. 도면 보안도 제품 경쟁력의 중요한 축이다. 국정원의 국가정보보안기본지침, 방위사업청의 방위산업보안업무훈 등과 같은 고객사 보안 요구에 맞춰 기능을 추가 개발한 바 있다. 또한 이외에도 고객사들과 협업 과정에서 도면 공유를 통제하고 외부 유출 시 열람을 제한하는 기능에도 투자하고 있다. 최 대표는 “기업이 수개월, 수년간 투자해 만든 도면에는 수많은 노하우가 담겨 있다”며 “협업 과정의 유출을 최소화하고 도면이 외부로 나갔더라도 열람을 제한하는 등 보안 기능 강화에 힘을 쏟고 있다”고 말했다. 회사는 글로벌 사업 확대 발판 마련을 위해 기업공개(IPO)를 준비하고 있다. 상장 주관사 실사를 마쳤으며, 2027년 거래소 상장 심사 청구와 2027~2028년 상장을 목표로 준비하고 있다. 최 대표는 “글로벌 진출을 앞당길 자금을 확보하고 해외 고객에게 한국 상장사라는 신뢰를 주기 위해 상장을 추진한다”고 설명했다. 이어 “직스 스페이스의 연내 정식 출시를 추진하고, 내년 1월 CES 2027에서 글로벌 론칭에 나설 계획”이라면서 “미국·일본·베트남 등에서는 사업·기술 협력을 추진하는 등 글로벌 사업에 속도를 내겠다”고 덧붙였다. 강성전 기자 castlekang@etnews.com

https://www.sbctv.gr/2026/11/%CF%81%CF%8.title: Ρωσία: Το Κρεμλίνο αφήνει ανοιχτή συνάντηση Πούτιν με τον Κιμ
https://www.sbctv.gr/2026/11/%CF%81%CF%8.p1: Μια πιθανή συνάντηση Πούτιν με τον ηγέτη της Βόρειας Κορέας Κιμ Γιονγκ Ουν εξαρτάται από την παρουσία του δεύτερου στη σύνοδο Οικονομικής Συνεργασίας Ασίας-Ειρηνικού, στη Σεντζέν της Κίνας. Αυτό δήλωσε ο εκπρόσωπος του Κρεμλίνου Ντμίτρι Πεσκόφ, απαντώντας σε ερώτηση για το ενδεχόμενο επαφής των δύο ηγετών. Νωρίτερα, ο πρόεδρος των Ηνωμένων Πολιτειών Ντόναλντ Τραμπ είχε επίσης αναφέρει ότι ενδέχεται να συναντηθεί με τον Κιμ. Ο Πεσκόφ μίλησε τη Δευτέρα σε δημοσιογράφους και αναφέρθηκε παράλληλα στον σχεδιασμό των επαφών του Ρώσου προέδρου με τον Αμερικανό ομόλογό του. Οι δύο επιλογές για τη συνάντηση Πούτιν με τον Τραμπ Για το αναμενόμενο τετ α τετ των δύο προέδρων, ο εκπρόσωπος του Κρεμλίνου δήλωσε ότι δεν έχει καθοριστεί ακριβής ώρα. Περιγράφοντας τη μορφή που προτιμά η ρωσική πλευρά, είπε: «Μία επιλογή που θα προτιμούσαμε είναι μια προσυμφωνημένη συνάντηση — χωριστά, για να μιλήσουν ήρεμα επί μία ώρα ή περισσότερο». Ως εναλλακτική, ο Πεσκόφ ανέφερε μια κατ’ ιδίαν συνομιλία στο περιθώριο της συνόδου. Για την τελική επιλογή περιορίστηκε να πει: «Θα δούμε πώς θα εξελιχθεί». Η τριμερής της Σεντζέν και η παρακολούθηση από τη Σεούλ Νωρίτερα είχε γίνει γνωστό ότι οι Τραμπ, Σι Τζινπίνγκ και Πούτιν θα συναντηθούν στις 19 Νοεμβρίου, στο περιθώριο της ίδιας διοργάνωσης. Οι τρεις ηγέτες έχουν ήδη συνομιλήσει ανά δύο, αλλά η προγραμματισμένη τριμερής θα αποτελέσει την πρώτη επίσημη κοινή διαπραγμάτευσή τους. Η Νότια Κορέα είχε δηλώσει ότι παρακολουθεί την προετοιμασία των συνομιλιών ΗΠΑ, Κίνας και Ρωσίας. Τη θέση αυτή είχε διατυπώσει ο πρώτος υφυπουργός Εξωτερικών Παρκ Γιουν-τζου, όταν η τριμερής συζητούνταν ακόμη ως ενδεχόμενο. SBC Red Line Για τον Έλληνα αναγνώστη, αξίζει να παρακολουθηθεί ποιες από τις διμερείς επαφές θα πραγματοποιηθούν τελικά. Η διάκριση ανάμεσα στην προγραμματισμένη τριμερή και στις επαφές που παραμένουν υπό συζήτηση είναι ουσιαστική για την αποτίμηση της συνόδου. https://www.fnnews.com/news/202611171910.p1: 이달 초 일주일간 동료 교수들과 함께 유럽의 안보 관련 국제기관과 연구소들을 방문하였다. 우선 벨기에 브뤼셀에 소재한 북대서양조약기구(NATO.나토) 본부를 방문하여 인도태평양 지역 담당자들과 함께 나토와 한국 간의 안보협력 현황 및 향후 과제에 대해 의견을 나누었다. 이어 영국 런던으로 옮겨 세계적 안보연구기관인 국제전략문제연구소(IISS)에서 영국 및 독일 등에서 참가한 다른 연구자들과 함께 한국·유럽 안보협력 방안에 대해 워크숍을 가졌다. 그리고 영국 왕립합동군사연구소(RUSI)를 방문하여 영국을 포함한 나토 국가들과 안보협력 관련 이슈들에 대해 논의하였다.

https://newsonjapan.com/article/151423.p.title: Japan and Regional Leaders Strengthen Ties at Manila Summit | News On Japan
https://newsonjapan.com/article/151423.p.p1:
MANILA -
 Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi joined U.S. President Donald Trump and the leaders of Australia and India for a Quad summit in Manila on November 17th, where Trump described the four countries' relationships as among the world's most important partnerships and drew attention to Takaichi's toughness during an exchange with reporters.
https://newsonjapan.com/article/151423.p.p2: The meeting brought together Takaichi, Trump, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi as the four countries sought to strengthen cooperation on regional security, economic resilience, energy and emerging technologies. Speaking ahead of the summit, Trump emphasized the close relationships among the four nations, saying they represented some of the most important partnerships in the world. He also made a lighthearted remark about the personalities of his fellow leaders, describing Modi as a very tough man before suggesting that Takaichi might be even tougher. The comment came as the four leaders gathered for photographs and answered questions from reporters, providing a moment of humor ahead of discussions on regional and international challenges. At the summit, Takaichi welcomed the opportunity to hold the first Quad leaders' meeting involving the current four leaders and expressed appreciation for Trump's participation. "The Quad has always contributed to peace in this region," Takaichi said, emphasizing that the four countries would continue working with regional partners to shape the future of the Indo-Pacific. She identified maritime security, economic security, energy and critical emerging technologies as priority areas for cooperation, arguing that stronger regional independence and resilience were essential to achieving a free and open Indo-Pacific. Takaichi also called for renewed momentum behind the Quad, describing it as a strategically important framework capable of delivering practical results for countries across the region. The four leaders reaffirmed their opposition to unilateral attempts to change the status quo through force or coercion and expressed serious concern about economic pressure, including arbitrary export restrictions. They also discussed the protection of critical supply chains, maritime cooperation and energy security. The Quad meeting was part of an extensive diplomatic schedule for Takaichi in Manila, where she participated in several ASEAN-related gatherings and held bilateral talks with regional leaders. At the ASEAN Plus Three summit, bringing together the 10 ASEAN members with Japan, China and South Korea, Takaichi emphasized the importance of practical cooperation in maintaining regional stability and prosperity. She highlighted financial cooperation, food security, disaster response and efforts to combat organized crime as areas where the participating countries could deepen their partnerships. Takaichi said Japan would continue supporting ASEAN's central role and unity in regional diplomacy while promoting her vision of an evolved Free and Open Indo-Pacific, designed to help countries strengthen their independence and resilience. At the fourth Asia Zero Emission Community summit, Takaichi outlined proposals aimed at simultaneously strengthening energy security, supporting economic growth and advancing decarbonization. She called for the AZEC framework to evolve into a more ambitious second phase, describing energy security and economic resilience as increasingly important challenges for Asian economies. Among the proposals was the establishment of an Asian oil security task force, working with the International Energy Agency to develop rules for emergency oil releases and improve coordination among regional countries. Takaichi also proposed a new IEA base in Tokyo and greater cooperation on petroleum stockpiles, including arrangements linked to a joint reserve initiative led by the Philippines. Other priorities included expanding the use of biofuels, promoting small modular nuclear reactors and developing next-generation energy technologies. She announced plans for a Bridge Asia Initiative to encourage the development of a common Asian market in advanced industries, while working with the Asian Development Bank and other institutions to accelerate transition financing and investment in green transformation. Takaichi also promoted closer economic and energy cooperation between Asian consumers and oil-producing countries in the Middle East under the Power Gulf initiative. Rejecting the argument that climate action necessarily damages economic performance, she said environmental protection and economic growth could be achieved together. At the Japan-ASEAN summit, Takaichi reaffirmed Japan's commitment to a regional order based on freedom, openness, diversity, inclusiveness and the rule of law. She welcomed the adoption of a joint statement on economic resilience, saying stronger partnerships with ASEAN countries would contribute to regional prosperity. Japan also hosted its first summit with Mekong countries in six years, with Takaichi describing the Mekong region as a key part of her Indo-Pacific strategy. She pledged continued Japanese support for sustainable development, reliable artificial intelligence and digital technologies, improved regional connectivity, stable energy supplies and stronger supply chains. Takaichi also met Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul, referring to their conversations at a dinner the previous evening and welcoming another opportunity to discuss bilateral cooperation. She expressed appreciation for Thailand's support for Japan's Indo-Pacific vision and called for stronger collaboration to improve regional economic independence and resilience. In a separate meeting with South Korean President Lee Jae Myung, Takaichi emphasized the importance of maintaining close relations between Tokyo and Seoul as international conditions become increasingly difficult. She recalled their earlier meeting in Andong, Lee's hometown, in May, describing the local scenery as a particularly memorable experience. Takaichi said relations between Japan and South Korea were especially important under current international circumstances and called for the continuation of shuttle diplomacy, under which the two countries' leaders make regular reciprocal visits. She expressed hope that the arrangement would help strengthen bilateral ties and maintain communication between the governments. Lee welcomed the improvement in relations, saying public attitudes toward each other's countries had become considerably more favorable and had reached what could be described as historically high levels. He also pointed to expanding people-to-people exchanges, growing economic cooperation and closer collaboration on security matters. The South Korean president expressed appreciation for an invitation to visit Japan in January and said he looked forward to meeting Takaichi again. The series of meetings underscored Japan's efforts to strengthen diplomatic and economic relationships across Asia while maintaining close coordination with the United States. For Takaichi, the Quad summit provided an opportunity to demonstrate Japan's commitment to regional security and economic cooperation alongside three major Indo-Pacific partners. Trump's public praise of the four-country partnership, together with his remarks about Takaichi's toughness, added a personal dimension to a gathering focused on strengthening cooperation at a time of growing international uncertainty.

https://news.webindia123.com/news/Articl.title: NVIDIA expands supply chain commitments to support AI infrastructure growth
https://news.webindia123.com/news/Articl.p1: According to the Company's press release, working with Amkor Technology, Foxconn, Kinsus Interconnect Technology, Samsung Electro-Mechanics, Siliconware Precision Industries (SPIL) and TSMC, NVIDIA is expanding manufacturing capacity across substrates, advanced packaging, wafer and contract manufacturing to scale production of its current and next-generation accelerated computing platforms. Our supply chain is a strategic advantage, said Debora Shoquist, executive vice president of operations at NVIDIA. Our work with these partners builds on our manufacturing foundation for long-term growth, expanding capacity across components, advanced packaging and system production to deliver the accelerated computing platforms our customers need. NVIDIA is expanding its substrate supply commitments with Kinsus and Samsung Electro-Mechanics, adding manufacturing capacity and improving production capabilities at existing factories. Under a new agreement with NVIDIA, Kinsus plans to expand its advanced ABF package substrate manufacturing capacity dedicated to NVIDIA by more than 3.5x over current levels from its Youth campus in Taoyuan, Taiwan. As per the press release, production is expected to begin in the second half of 2027, with the additional capacity targeted for the third quarter of 2028. This multiyear agreement builds on the companies existing supplier relationship and supports NVIDIAs long-term supply planning for its accelerated computing platforms. We believe AI will be one of the most important technology transitions of our lifetime, said Scott Chen, CEO and president of Kinsus. After more than a decade of partnership with NVIDIA, we are excited to continue building the future together. NVIDIA and Samsung Electro-Mechanics have amended their existing substrate supply agreement to improve operational capabilities at existing factories in support of increased production of NVIDIAs accelerated computing platforms. The amendment builds on the companies previously announced multiyear collaboration supporting substrate manufacturing in Sejong and Busan, South Korea, for NVIDIAs compute and high-speed networking technologies. By combining our world-class substrate fine-processing technology and high-reliability MLCC technology, we will perfectly fulfil our role as a total solution provider so that NVIDIAs AI platform can be supplied to the global market on time, with the highest performance and quality, said Duck-Hyun Chang, CEO of Samsung Electro-Mechanics. NVIDIAs advanced packaging plans include a new capacity expansion with SPIL and previously announced agreements supporting Amkors manufacturing expansion in the U.S. and South Korea. NVIDIA is supporting Amkors expansion of advanced packaging capacity in Arizona and South Korea through multiyear agreements announced in July and October 2026, totalling nearly $3 billion. The agreements include prepayments to help Amkor scale manufacturing capacity for NVIDIAs long-term production needs. Our agreements with NVIDIA support investments in Arizona and South Korea that will serve multiple generations of AI platforms, said Kevin Engel, president and CEO of Amkor. That long-term planning allows us to advance our packaging technologies and add manufacturing capacity as NVIDIAs production needs grow. NVIDIA and SPIL are expanding advanced packaging operations in Taiwan under a multiyear agreement supported by multibillion-dollar funding from NVIDIA. The expansion will increase contracted advanced packaging capacity dedicated to NVIDIA by mid-2029. The project includes new production lines with turnkey support spanning bumping, interposer wafer fabrication, assembly and testing. These capabilities support semiconductor products with demanding requirements for computing performance, bandwidth, power efficiency and system integration. SPIL is proud to strengthen our collaboration with NVIDIA, said C.W. Tsai, CEO and chairman of the board of SPIL. This agreement enhances our ability to support nextgeneration packaging technologies and deliver the performance and reliability required for future AI systems. The third quarter marked the first volume shipment of NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 and Vera CPUs for agentic AI. These products take advantage of TSMCs 5nm, 3nm and CoWoS advanced packaging technologies. TSMC and NVIDIA share a longstanding partnership built on semiconductor innovation, said Dr. Kevin Zhang, senior vice president and deputy co-COO at TSMC. This deep collaboration allows us to plan for future technology requirements and prepare our manufacturing capabilities as NVIDIA brings new platforms to market. Foxconn continues to deepen its collaboration with NVIDIA across next-generation GPU and networking platforms, said Young Liu, chairman of Foxconn. By leveraging its integrated global production network spanning Asia, North America, and Europe, Foxconn is well-positioned to support the volume ramp-up of next-generation AI infrastructure. These commitments build on NVIDIAs decades-long partnerships and recent commitments announced in October for manufacturing expansions with Amkor, IBIDEN, King Yuan Electronics (KYEC), Samsung Electro-Mechanics, SPIL and Unimicron. Those plans included an aggregate 2.5x increase in substrate capacity over three years, expanded advanced packaging, a doubling of semiconductor testing capacity from 2026 to 2027 and a 15x increase in SPILs optical-engine capacity by mid-2027, with aims for another doubling by the end of 2028. Our strong and long-standing collaboration with NVIDIA has continued to develop in the area of high-performance IC package substrates, said Koji Kawashima, president and chief executive officer at IBIDEN. Through the expansion of our Ono Plant, we will continue to strengthen our production capabilities and meet growing demand. Our work with NVIDIA demonstrates the value of close collaboration between chip design and semiconductor testing, said Gauss Chang, president at KYEC. Expanding our testing operations into the United States builds on that relationship and brings our capabilities closer to NVIDIAs growing US manufacturing supply chain. As AI reshapes industries and societies around the world, trusted partnerships and supply chain collaboration have never been more important, said SC Chien, chairman of Unimicron. The advanced substrate capacity investment underscores the strength of our partnership with NVIDIA and our shared commitment to support the rapid growth of AI infrastructure. By investing in advanced substrate technologies and manufacturing capabilities, Unimicron is well-positioned to help customers unlock new opportunities and share in the tremendous growth of the AI era. (ANI)

https://www.segye.com:443/newsView/20261.p1: 이재명 대통령이 18일(현지시간) 시진핑 중국 국가주석에게 한반도 문제에 대한 건설적 역할을 요청한 것은 미·중·러 정상회담을 하루 앞두고 북핵 등 한반도 현안에 한국의 입장을 반영하기 위한 외교적 대응으로 풀이된다. 강대국 간 협의에서 한국이 소외될 수 있다는 이른바 ‘한국 패싱’ 우려가 나오는 가운데, 한반도의 평화와 안정이 중국에도 공동이익이라는 점을 내세워 협력을 당부한 것이다. 시 주석은 북·미 대화 등 긴장 완화 노력을 지지한다는 뜻을 밝혔지만 중국 측 회담 결과 발표에는 한반도 관련 내용이 담기지 않았다.
https://www.segye.com:443/newsView/20261.p2: ◆미·중·러 회담 앞 중국 역할론 부각 위성락 국가안보실장은 회담 후 서면브리핑에서 한반도 문제가 ‘우리의 사활적 이익’이라는 이 대통령의 인식을 전하며, 남북 간 긴장 완화와 평화공존을 위한 중국의 건설적 역할을 요청했다고 밝혔다. 위 실장은 시 주석이 “중국은 한반도 문제 해결을 위한 건설적 역할을 지속해 나갈 것”이라고 했다고 전했다. 특히 시 주석은 최근 북·중 관계 동향을 설명하고 북·미 대화 등 한반도 긴장을 낮추기 위한 다양한 노력을 지지한다고 했다. 북한과 긴밀한 관계를 유지하는 중국이 대화 재개에 협력할 수 있다는 의사를 한국 측에 밝힌 것이다. 이 대통령은 지난 1월 베이징 정상회담에서도 북핵을 비롯한 한반도 현안에 중국의 중재 역할을 요청했다. 이번에는 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 시 주석, 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령이 19일 선전에서 처음으로 3자 정상회담을 갖는다는 점에서 외교적 무게가 다르다. 핵군축과 국제 안보 현안 등이 거론되지만 북핵 문제가 정식 의제에 포함되는지는 확인되지 않았다. 한반도 문제가 한국의 참여 없이 논의될 가능성에 대비해 중국 정상에게 한국의 이해관계를 직접 설명한 셈이다. 특히 강대국 간 핵군축 논의가 북핵 문제로 이어질 경우 북한 비핵화보다 핵전력의 규모와 운용을 제한하는 군비통제에 초점이 맞춰질 수 있다는 우려가 있다. 미국 본토를 위협하는 장거리 핵전력과 한국을 겨냥한 단거리 핵전력이 서로 다르게 취급될 가능성도 경계 대상이다. 청와대는 지난 17일 ‘제2의 얄타회담’ 우려에 관해 한반도 문제 등 국익과 직결된 사안에 한국의 입장과 이해관계가 충분히 반영돼야 한다는 입장을 밝힌 바 있다.

https://monocle.com/affairs/trump-xi-and.title: Trump, Xi and Putin’s Shenzhen face-to-face meeting proves that in-person summits still matter - Monocle
https://monocle.com/affairs/trump-xi-and.p1: Today’s trilateral summit between Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin might be as significant as the Yalta Conference in 1945, in which the three great Allies carved up the world map after the Second World War. But it could just as easily be a repeat of Anchorage : Trump and Putin’s meaningless meet-and-greet in Alaska last year.
https://monocle.com/affairs/trump-xi-and.p2: The context of economic discussion is what lubricates this particular ménage à trois. Xi is not hosting his counterparts in Beijing – a setting that would lend a political overtone – but in Shenzhen . This week, China’s tech hub is dazzling crowds with laser-light shows and more than 100 Fortune 500 CEOs have flown into the city. Interestingly, the roster for the summit comprises “member economies” rather than states, so Hong Kong and Taiwan are able to participate. But the frenzy will reach a crescendo today as the leaders of China, Russia and the US retreat from the city to the Qilin Mountain Villa: a location that feels markedly different from San Francisco, Lima and Busan, which hosted the past three bilateral Asia-Pacific Economic Co-operation (Apec) summits with Xi.
